name: nist
description: NIST Privacy Framework Core Functions and Categories

rules.condition: data_inventory OR data_mapping OR data_catalog OR asset_management
rules.question_form: Is there a comprehensive inventory of personal data collected and processed?
rules.description: ID.IM: Systems, products, and data actions are inventoried

rules.question_form: Is the organization's role in the data ecosystem understood?
rules.description: ID.BE: Organization's mission, stakeholders, and supply chain are understood

rules.question_form: Has a privacy risk assessment been conducted?
rules.description: ID.RA: Privacy risks are identified and assessed

rules.question_form: Are there established privacy governance policies?
rules.description: GV.PO: Policies establish governance over privacy risk

rules.question_form: Is there a defined privacy risk management strategy?
rules.description: GV.RM: Risk management processes are established

rules.condition: training OR awareness OR education OR privacy_culture
rules.question_form: Is there privacy awareness training for personnel?
rules.description: GV.AT: Workforce is privacy-aware and trained

rules.condition: monitoring OR audit OR review OR continuous_improvement
rules.question_form: Are privacy practices regularly monitored and reviewed?
rules.description: GV.MT: Privacy practices are monitored and reviewed

rules.question_form: Are there controls over data processing activities?
rules.description: CT.DM: Data processing is managed to minimize privacy risk

rules.question_form: Is data disassociated from individuals where possible?
rules.description: CT.DP: Data is disassociated from individuals and devices

rules.question_form: Are data protection policies implemented and enforced?
rules.description: CT.PP: Data protection policies, processes, and procedures maintained

rules.question_form: Are there clear privacy communications to individuals?
rules.description: CM.PO: Policies establish communication of privacy practices

rules.condition: consent OR notice OR choice OR opt_out
rules.question_form: Are individuals aware of and can consent to data processing?
rules.description: CM.AW: Individuals are aware of data processing and its purposes

rules.condition: security_controls OR safeguards OR encryption OR access_management
rules.question_form: Are there security safeguards protecting personal data?
rules.description: PR.DS: Data security safeguards are implemented
PR.AC: Identities and credentials are managed appropriately

rules.question_form: Are there breach detection and response capabilities?
rules.description: PR.DS: Security of data is maintained
